battle.name: 帕達里戰爭
battle.theater: 布宜諾斯艾利斯省帕達里堡
battle.brief: 一八二一年九月二十八日，布宜諾斯艾利斯省邊境帕達里堡一帶，聯邦派省民兵騎兵與邊民武裝擊潰國民政府遠征軍。遠征由里維達維亞政府派遣，企圖以新建的國民軍終結各省考迪羅的割據；曼努埃爾·多雷戈臨陣倒戈，成為勝負關鍵。西班牙方陣長槍的餘緒留在省民兵操典與長矛騎兵手上，已非戰場主力。

kit.name: 長槍
kit.history: 方陣的長矛讓火槍隊站在後面。密西西比之後，長矛和火槍一起站住了。

countries: 這是一場內戰，交戰雙方同屬拉普拉塔河兩岸聯合省的阿根廷人，卻分屬中央政府與省級聯邦派兩個陣營。中央一方是布宜諾斯艾利斯城裡一八二一年九月新組成的國民政府，最高執政官貝納迪諾·里維達維亞主張結束一八二〇年塞佩達會戰後的「無政府年」，以常備軍與全國稅收重建秩序；其指揮系統是新建的「聯合民族軍」，由上校胡安·拉蒙·巴爾卡爾塞任司令，遠征帕達里的野戰縱隊由殖民長曼努埃爾·多雷戈直接帶領，隊內另有以拿破崙舊部為主、由法國流亡少校亞歷山大·杜波依斯率領的「外籍軍團」。聯邦一方則以各省考迪羅為核心：聖菲省長埃斯塔尼斯勞·洛佩斯派出省級騎兵，布宜諾斯艾利斯省由聯邦派省長曼努埃爾·德·薩拉特亞主持，並以省民兵、邊境防衛隊與山民武裝為主幹，帕達里堡的守軍亦屬此方。兩邊都沒有外國正規軍參戰，編制與裝備卻幾乎完全對立：一方是歐式新規則營，另一方是西班牙舊制留下的省民兵與邊地騎士。
countriesEn: This was not a war between two states but a civil war inside the collapsing United Provinces of the Rio de la Plata, fought between the national government in Buenos Aires and the provincial federalist camp. The national side was the government formed in Buenos Aires in September 1821 under the Supreme Director Bernardino Rivadavia, who meant to end the so-called Year of Anarchy that had followed the 1820 Battle of Cepeda by creating a permanent national army and consolidating national revenues. Its command structure was the newly raised Ejercito de los Pueblos Unidos (Army of the United Peoples), commanded by Colonel Juan Ramon Balcarce; the expeditionary column that marched on Padari was led directly by Colonel Manuel Dorrego, and it included a Legion Extranjera (Foreign Legion) of former Napoleonic soldiers under the French emigre Major Alexander Dubois. The federalist side was organised around the provincial caudillos: Estanislao Lopez, governor of Santa Fe, sent the provincial cavalry; Buenos Aires Province was presided over by the federalist governor Manuel de Sarratea; the backbone of their force was the provincial militia, the frontier garrisons and the montoneras of the border population, and the garrison of the fort of Padari belonged to the same side. No foreign regular army fought in the contest, yet the two sides were almost mirror images in organisation and equipment: on one side a European-style regular battalion, on the other a provincial militia still drilled on Spanish ordinances.
people: 關鍵人物集中在三方。里維達維亞是這場衝突的發起者：他上台三日後即取得國會授予的特別權限，廢止八月六日布宜諾斯艾利斯省的普選投票，並派兵進攻省內；戰敗後他在十月二十七日辭職，隨後流亡英國，後來在智利與玻利瓦爾時代擔任外交使節。多雷戈是全場最關鍵的人物：這位生於布宜諾斯艾利斯、曾以邊民首領身分加入西班牙殖民軍的殖民長，一度被視為最能統合邊境各省的人選，卻在遠征途中倒向聯邦派，率部加入洛佩斯一方，遠征軍因此在接戰當日崩潰；聯邦派隨即把他推為布宜諾斯艾利斯省的實力人物，他在一八二八年被拉瓦爾以叛亂罪名槍決，直接引爆其後數十年的內戰。洛佩斯以「聯邦之父」之名坐鎮聖菲，決定性地投入騎兵；巴爾卡爾塞與杜波依斯代表國民軍的歐洲化軍官團，前者統籌全局，後者以數十名老兵守住前鋒。政治上的反對派核心則是民選省長馬丁·羅德里格斯——其八月選票被中央廢止——以及省議員伊爾德豐索·拉莫斯·梅希亞。一八二一年十月，一批國民軍軍官因不滿政府的財政與干預政策遞交辭呈，史稱「擁護派」，此後軍官團便沿聯邦與單元兩條路線分道揚鑣。
peopleEn: The key figures fall into three groups. Rivadavia was the author of the expedition: three days after taking office on 26 September 1821 he obtained extraordinary powers from the Congress, annulled the 6 August elections in Buenos Aires Province and sent troops into the province; after the defeat he resigned on 27 October and left for England, later serving as an envoy in Chile and to Bolivar. Dorrego was the decisive personality on the field: a Buenos Aires-born colonel who had risen as a frontier militia chief in the colonial war and was seen as the man best able to unite the frontier provinces, he crossed over to the federalists during the march and brought his men over to Lopez's side, and the expedition collapsed on the day of contact; the federalists consequently made him the strong man of Buenos Aires Province, and his execution by Lavalle in 1828 triggered decades of civil war. Lopez, known as the Patriarch of the Federation, sat at Santa Fe and committed his cavalry to the fight; Balcarce and Dubois embodied the European officer corps of the national army, the former directing the operation and the latter holding the vanguard with a few dozen veteran legionaries. The political core of the opposition was the popularly elected governor Martin Rodriguez, whose August votes the central government annulled, together with the provincial legislator Ildefonso Ramos Mexia. In October 1821 a group of national army officers resigned in protest against the fiscal and interventionist policies of the government, the so-called adheridos; from then on the officer corps split along the coming federalist and unitarian lines.
kits: 本卡兵器是十六世紀西班牙方陣使用的長槍：三米上下的硬木槍桿，鑲以鐵製槍頭，是「大方陣」的核心，槍手居中排成密集長廊，兩翼由火槍手與弩手掩護，槍與火槍合成同一個火力單位。這套裝備在一八二一年已經退下戰場：歐洲各國的野戰部隊都早已棄用長槍，仍在線列中保留槍兵的俄國遠在拉普拉塔河之外。但長槍並未完全消失，它以兩種方式留在這場戰爭裡。其一在制度上：西班牙舊制民兵條例在每個民兵營中保留槍兵隊，用來守備邊境堡壘，而帕達里正是一座這樣的堡壘；市區民兵按同一套操典操練，槍兵隊與火槍隊在方陣中互相掩護，一八二一年雙方步兵的線列、齊射與中央密集的火器，正是這套血統的另一種樣子。其二在功能上：長槍的直接後裔是長矛，聯邦方省民兵騎兵與邊民多持三米以上長矛，衝鋒時壓低矛尖，這正是長槍戰法的騎兵版本，也是決定這場戰役的武器。此外，聯邦方騎兵配彎刀、獵槍與擲索套索，邊地武裝另有短矛與投槍；國民軍步兵是燧發滑膛火槍的線列步兵，配刺刀，外籍軍團老兵裝備法式長火槍，遠征軍攜帶數門野戰炮，另有騎兵中隊。糧秣靠牛車與騾隊，帕達里堡以木柵圍牆與火槍孔防守，堡內儲存火藥與給養。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the pike used by the sixteenth-century Spanish tercia: a shaft of some three metres of hardwood tipped with an iron point, the core of the square formation, with the pikemen standing in the centre as a dense corridor and musketeers and crossbowmen covering the flanks, so that pike and shot formed a single unit of fire. By 1821 that equipment had left the field of battle: every European field army had already abandoned the pike, and Russia, the only power still keeping pikemen in the line, was nowhere near the Rio de la Plata. Yet the pike did not vanish entirely, and it survives at Padari in two forms. First institutionally: Spanish militia ordinances kept a company of pikemen in each militia battalion to garrison the frontier forts, and Padari was exactly such a fort; the urban militias drilled on the same manual, pikemen and musketeers covering each other in the tercia, and the close-order linear formation and volley fire of both infantry lines at Padari in 1821 are the same bloodline in another form. Second functionally: the direct heir of the pike is the lance, and the federalist provincial cavalry and border riders carried lances of more than three metres, levelled at the charge; that was the mounted version of pike drill and the arm that decided the battle. Besides lances, the federalist horse used sabres, hunting guns and bolas, and the border bands also carried short pikes and javelins. The national infantry was a line battalion of flintlock smoothbore muskets with bayonets, the foreign legion veterans carried French model long muskets, the expedition brought a few field guns, and there was a mounted squadron. Supply rested on ox carts and mule trains; the fort of Padari was protected by a wooden palisade and musket loopholes, and powder and provisions were stored inside.
tactics: 遠征軍自九月初由布宜諾斯艾利斯出發，近兩百公里的陸路行軍，縱隊沿鄉間道路北行，步兵縱隊、騎兵、炮兵依序拉開，車隊與騾隊落在後方，行軍縱隊的長度遠超一路可警戒的範圍。聯邦方不與正面營壘硬撞：他們把主力集中於邊境一帶的起伏平原與河道地帶，先以游騎與散兵騷擾行軍縱隊，切斷後方車隊與糧道，再在遠征軍接近帕達里堡的當日，以集中起來的騎兵自兩翼及側後發動衝鋒，盡量避免讓線列步兵結成的火力正面發揮。國民軍以線列步兵的齊射迎戰，前鋒由外籍軍團老兵擔任，企圖以火槍射程與刺刀阻止騎兵接近；但多雷戈率部倒戈，使原定的包抄失去方向，遠征軍的中央與兩翼在同一時間失去支撐，齊射的密度再也無法維持。潰退時隊形完全散亂，許多士兵在涉渡鹹水河時溺斃，炮車與大部分輜重被聯邦方奪取。此役清楚顯示：線列營對上以騎兵與地形為主的省民兵，縱隊行軍與補給線的脆弱性，比射擊精度更致命。
tacticsEn: The expedition left Buenos Aires in early September and marched about two hundred kilometres overland, the column moving north along country roads, the infantry battalion, the cavalry and the guns stretched out in turn, with the carts and mule trains falling behind, so that the column was far longer than any march could be covered by. The federalists did not try to smash the front of the regular formation: they concentrated on the rolling plain and the watercourses around the border, harried the marching column with mounted patrols and loose bands, cut the baggage train and the supply route behind it, and then on the day the expedition reached the neighbourhood of the fort of Padari launched a concentrated cavalry charge against both flanks and the rear, doing their best to prevent the close-order infantry from ever delivering its fire. The national troops answered with volley fire from the line, the vanguard being held by the veterans of the foreign legion, who hoped to check the horsemen with musket range and bayonets; but Dorrego's defection deprived the intended envelopment of its direction, the centre and the wings of the expedition lost their support at the same moment, and the density of the volleys could no longer be maintained. In the rout the formation dissolved completely, many men drowned while fording the Salado, and the guns with most of the baggage fell into federalist hands. The battle showed plainly that when a linear battalion meets a provincial militia whose strength lies in cavalry and terrain, the vulnerability of marching columns and supply lines is more deadly than the accuracy of the shooting.
data: 各來源對雙方兵數的記載分歧頗大，較接近的說法是：遠征軍出發時約一千五百人上下，區間介乎一千至兩千之間，以線列步兵、騎兵與炮兵為骨幹，外籍軍團只有數十名老兵；聯邦方集結兵力在兩三千人上下，多為省民兵、邊民與聖菲騎兵，另加帕達里堡守軍。火炮方面，遠征軍攜帶數門輕型野戰炮，聯邦方在戰線上幾乎沒有成建制的炮兵。距離與時間：自布宜諾斯艾利斯至帕達里堡近兩百公里，行軍約兩週，九月二十八日交戰，全戰僅一日。損失方面，遠征軍全線潰散、逃散者眾，炮兵與輜重盡失，多人於鹹水河中溺斃；聯邦方基本完好，無人被俘的可靠記載。戰後影響的時距更短：里維達維亞政府於十月二十七日辭職，距戰敗不足一個月，首都與各省的中央機關隨即停擺。
dataEn: Sources differ widely on the numbers involved, and the figures closest to the mark are these: the expedition numbered about fifteen hundred men on the march, somewhere between one and two thousand, built on a close-order infantry battalion with cavalry and a small park of guns, while the foreign legion contributed only a few dozen veterans; the federalists gathered something in the order of two to three thousand men, mostly provincial militia, border riders and the cavalry of Santa Fe, plus the garrison of the fort of Padari. In the matter of artillery the expedition brought a few light field guns, whereas the federalists had practically no organised gun line on the battlefield. Distance and time: nearly two hundred kilometres from Buenos Aires to the fort of Padari, roughly a fortnight on the march, contact on 28 September, and the whole engagement lasted a single day. Losses: the expedition disintegrated completely, with stragglers scattered, the artillery and baggage all lost and a number of men drowned in the Salado; the federalist force came through essentially intact, and there is no reliable record of prisoners being taken. The aftermath came even faster: the Rivadavia government resigned on 27 October, less than a month after the defeat, and the central institutions in the capital and in the provinces immediately stopped functioning.
cause: 遠征帕達里是中央集權路線與省級聯邦傳統正面碰撞的結果，直接導火線有三條。第一，里維達維亞政府依據國會授予的特別權限，廢止了八月六日布宜諾斯艾利斯省的普選投票，宣布由中央另行安排民政，省級自治的民意基礎被視為無效。第二是財政措施：政府把各省海關與國有地產收益收歸中央，又向省際商界徵收戰爭借款，應付國民軍與外籍軍團的開支，商人與省長聯手抗拒，薩拉特亞政府的合法性正建立在反對中央財政掠奪的訴求上。第三是軍事目標本身：里維達維亞要把新式的常備國民軍開進省份，用它取代省民兵與考迪羅的武裝，這等於直接否定一八二〇年塞佩達會戰之後各省形成的實際自治。深層原因則是塞佩達會戰之後「無政府年」留下的權力真空：中央缺乏穩定稅源、常備軍與強制力，各省考迪羅以保護地方秩序為名，行使完整的行政與軍事權力，中央與省級的衝突因此在所難免。
causeEn: The march on Padari was the result of a head-on collision between the centralising project and the provincial federalist tradition, with three immediate triggers. First, acting on the extraordinary powers granted by the Congress, the Rivadavia government annulled the general election of 6 August in Buenos Aires Province and announced that the civil authorities would be reorganised from the centre, so that the popular basis of provincial autonomy was declared void. Second came the fiscal measures: the government took the customs revenues and the rents of the national assets of the provinces into its own hands and levied a war loan on the provincial merchant communities to pay for the national army and the foreign legion, and merchants and provincial governors resisted together, which left the Sarratea administration resting on a platform of opposition to financial extraction by the centre. Third was the military aim itself: Rivadavia meant to march a new-style permanent national army into the provinces and use it to replace the provincial militias and the armed retinues of the caudillos, which amounted to a direct denial of the de facto provincial autonomy that had formed after the Battle of Cepeda in 1820. The deeper cause lay in the vacuum left by the Year of Anarchy after Cepeda: with no stable tax base, no permanent army and no coercive power of its own, the centre could only watch the provincial caudillos administer justice and command armed forces in the name of keeping order, and the collision between the two was unavoidable.
impact: 帕達里一役是阿根廷內戰的分水嶺。中央政府第一次以正規軍進攻省級政權，卻在一天之內被徹底擊破，這個結果立刻改變了力量對比：里維達維亞辭職，國會停擺，首都與其餘省份宣布退出聯合省，一八二二年聯盟單元派以布宜諾斯艾利斯為中心重建，聯邦派則由沿岸省份主導。此後半個多世紀，阿根廷在兩條路線之間反覆攤牌：一八二〇年代中期召開的布宜諾斯艾利斯國會推動國家統一與全國軍，而一八三一年的聯邦條約由沿岸省份確認各省自治，內戰斷續到一八八〇年才以國家單一制的落幕收場。制度層面的後果更為長久：中央政府要建立常備軍、統一財政與劃一稅制的嘗試屢次重演，也屢次被省級力量擱置，直至二十世紀國家才重新推行統一的稅收與軍制。個人層面上，多雷戈的倒戈使他成為聯邦派領袖，他在一八二八年被拉瓦爾以叛亂罪名槍決，隨即引發全國性內戰，把一場邊境衝突變成長達半個世紀的國家分裂。
impactEn: Padari was the watershed of the Argentine civil wars. For the first time the central government attacked a provincial government with a regular army, and in a single day it was shattered completely, which immediately shifted the balance of forces: Rivadavia resigned, the Congress stopped working, the capital and the remaining provinces withdrew from the United Provinces, a unitary league was rebuilt around Buenos Aires in 1822, and the federalist side came to be led by the littoral provinces. For more than half a century afterwards Argentina repeatedly refought the same argument: the congresses that met in Buenos Aires in the middle of the 1820s drove for national unity and a national army, while the Federal Pact of 1831 confirmed provincial autonomy, and the civil wars dragged on until 1880 closed them with the victory of a single national state. The institutional consequences were even longer lived: every later attempt by the centre to build a permanent army, unify the finances and impose a single tax system was repeated and repeatedly blocked by provincial power, and it was not until the twentieth century that the country recovered a unified fiscal and military system. At the personal level Dorrego's defection made him the leading federalist, and his execution by Lavalle on a charge of rebellion in 1828 triggered a national civil war, turning a frontier clash into a half-century of national division.
result: 聯邦派在帕達里取得決定性勝利：遠征軍在接戰當日被擊潰，野戰炮與輜重盡失，士兵在逃散中損失慘重，作為有效武力的國民軍被證明不堪一戰。政治上，這場勝利直接埋葬了里維達維亞政府，他於十月二十七日辭職，首都的中央機關隨即瓦解，聯合省在成立不到半個世紀後解體，各省各自為政。聯邦派獲得兩重收穫：一是把國家權力的主導權交回省級考迪羅，聖菲的洛佩斯與布宜諾斯艾利斯省在隨後數年控制聯邦的方向；二是多雷戈的轉投證明省級聯邦陣營可以靠騎兵與地方武裝，擊敗按歐洲條令訓練的正規軍。戰役之後並未帶來和平：中央政府以聯盟單元派的形式在內陸各省重建，與沿岸省份的聯邦條約路線長期對抗，阿根廷內戰由此拉開序幕，一直打到一八八〇年才算收場。帕達里堡的意義則在於它留下一個未被解決的問題：控制邊境堡壘只是象徵，決定邊疆走向的始終是省級騎兵與地方實力。
resultEn: The federalists won a decisive victory at Padari: the expedition was destroyed on the day of contact, the field guns and baggage were all lost, the men were badly hit while scattering, and the national army was shown to be ineffective in the field. Politically the victory buried the Rivadavia government; he resigned on 27 October, the central institutions of the capital collapsed, and the United Provinces came apart before they were half a century old, leaving each province to govern itself. The federalists gained in two ways: the direction of national power passed back to the provincial caudillos, and Santa Fe under Lopez together with Buenos Aires Province controlled the course of the federation for the following years; and Dorrego's defection demonstrated that the provincial federal camp could defeat a regular army trained on European ordinances by relying on cavalry and local armed bands. The battle brought no peace: the central government was rebuilt in the inland provinces in the shape of the unitary league and faced the federal pact route of the littoral provinces for decades, and the Argentine civil wars ran from Padari to 1880. What Padari left behind was an unresolved question: the holding of a frontier fort was only symbolic, and what decided the frontier was always the provincial horse and local armed strength.
